intent: Bring the two remaining over-cap shell test suites in linux_configuration/tests under the 250-line cap without changing a single assertion or its result.
scope: Non-goal: changing, weakening, skipping or deleting any check
Non-goal: reformatting test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh, which was already shfmt-dirty (2-space indent) before this change
changes: test_pacman_wrapper_security.sh: tests 1-12 and 13-19 moved into two sourced libs, each wrapped in a function and called in the original order. The trailing checks keep their heredocs and their trap ... EXIT in the entry script, so trap scope is unchanged.

test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh: the config/guard checks and the claude_usage checks moved into two sourced libs. The setup half stays in the entry deliberately: the five fake $BIN_DIR binaries are written with heredocs, and a seam inside a heredoc yields a lib that will not parse.

Both i3blocks lib functions end in an explicit `return 0`. Their last statement is a `|| fail ...` conditional, which as a function tail under `set -e` would become the return value and abort a fully passing run; `fail` itself exits, so reaching the end means every check passed.
Both entry scripts keep their filenames, because .github/workflows/shell-tests.yml runs these suites by filename.

verification.command: bash -n on both entries and all four new libs
shellcheck on each new lib ALONE (no -x), plus shellcheck -x on both entries
verification.evidence: LIBS CLEAN and ENTRY CLEAN for both suites. No suppression added.

verification.command: bash test_pacman_wrapper_security.sh, diffed against the same suite run from a detached worktree at HEAD
verification.evidence: OUTPUT BYTE-IDENTICAL PRE/POST SPLIT; both runs exit 0.

verification.command: bash test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh, diffed against the pre-split run captured before editing
verification.evidence: OUTPUT BYTE-IDENTICAL PRE/POST SPLIT; both runs exit 0, ending in 'All i3blocks efficiency regression tests passed.'

verification.command: shfmt -d on the pacman entry and its two libs
verification.evidence: SHFMT CLEAN. The i3blocks files are shfmt-dirty both before and after: the original uses 2-space indent, and the new libs inherit the style of the code they hold rather than being reformatted.
63 -> 61 violations; neither suite appears any more.

risks: The libs are only valid when sourced from their entry script, which owns the helpers, paths and fake $BIN_DIR binaries. Running one directly is not supported and never was a use case.
A future check appended to an i3blocks lib must keep the `return 0` last, or a passing run can abort on the set -e function-tail trap.
rollback: git revert the commit; both entry scripts return to single files and the four libs disappear.

After rollback, run both suites and confirm test_pacman_wrapper_security.sh ends in 'All Tests Passed!' and test_i3blocks_efficiency.sh in 'All i3blocks efficiency regression tests passed.', each exiting 0.
